services.name: Learn to Sail
services.desc: Located directly across the street from Portage Yacht Club at 8955 Dexter Pinckney Road, Midwest Sailing is your ultimate destination for all boating and lake activity needs. Conveniently located, we provide an extensive selection of products and services that cater to every aspect of your boating experience. Our offerings include sailboat sales and parts, hoist sales and repairs, trailer sales and repairs, and dock sales and services. Additionally, we offer winter and summer storage, ensuring your boat is safely stored and ready for use when the season changes.
